gloss: first shrine visit of the year

definitions.gloss: first shrine/temple visit of the new year
definitions.explanation: The traditional practice of visiting a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple for the first time in the new year.

examples.english: To go for the first shrine visit of the year.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}で{今年|ことし}の{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}をした。
examples.english: I made a wish for this year at the new year shrine visit.

examples.japanese: {明治神宮|めいじじんぐう}の{初詣|はつもうで}は{混雑|こんざつ}する。
examples.english: Meiji Shrine gets crowded during hatsumode.

notes:
{初詣|はつもうで} is the first shrine or temple visit of the new year, one of Japan's most important New Year traditions.

TIMING:
Most people go between New Year's Eve midnight and January 3rd ({三|さん}が{日|にち}). The most crowded time is midnight on New Year's Eve.

ACTIVITIES:
- お{参|まい}りする: to pray/pay respects
- おみくじを{引|ひ}く: to draw a fortune slip
- お{守|まも}りを{買|か}う: to buy a protective charm
- {絵馬|えま}を{書|か}く: to write wishes on wooden plaques
- {甘酒|あまざけ}を{飲|の}む: to drink sweet sake

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {初詣|はつもうで}に{行|い}く: to go for hatsumode
- {初詣|はつもうで}で{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}をする: to make a New Year wish

NOTE:
People may visit either Shinto shrines ({神社|じんじゃ}) or Buddhist temples ({寺|てら}).
